title: Align MCP initialize instructions with config_lookup and symbol_at routing
outcome: The live MCP initialize instructions route literals/non-symbol text to search_text, configuration keys to config_lookup, and stack traces/build errors/diff hunks through symbol_at.
acceptance: McpApplication.Instructions assigns configuration keys to config_lookup and literals, messages, comments, and non-symbol text to search_text.
McpApplication.Instructions routes stack traces, build errors, and diff hunks through symbol_at(path, line).
The later product changeset bumps BuildInfo.Version, updates its contract tests, passes all required gates, and is independently reviewed.

completion.summary: Aligned MCP initialize instructions with config_lookup, search_text fallback, symbol_at routing, and the typed cold-start recovery contract.
